sections.installation:
1. Click ‘Add New’ in Plugins menu
  2. Search for ‘AjaxPress’
  3. Click ‘Install Now’
  4. Click ‘Activate’
  5. That’s it – your site is now faster! 🚀

Want to fine-tune? Visit Settings > AjaxPress for easy options.

Need help? Check our Quick Start Guide
sections.faq:
🤔 Will this make my site faster?

Yes! Your pages will load instantly because only new content loads, not the entire page.

👩‍💻 Do I need to know coding?

Not at all! Install the plugin and it works automatically. Simple settings are available if you want to customize.

🎨 Will this work with my theme?

Yes! AjaxPress works with nearly all WordPress themes. It keeps your design exactly the same, just makes it faster.

🔌 What about my other plugins?

AjaxPress is friendly with most WordPress plugins, including WooCommerce, contact forms, and SEO plugins.

🌟 How does AjaxPress improve my site?

No matter what type of WordPress site you have, AjaxPress makes it better! Blogs load articles instantly, portfolios showcase work smoothly, business sites handle inquiries faster, and community sites keep discussions flowing. Your visitors get a modern, app-like experience that makes browsing your site a pleasure.

📝 How does it handle forms?

Forms work smoothly – submissions happen instantly without page reload.

📱 What about mobile devices?

Works great on all devices! The fast loading is especially nice on mobile.

🆘 Where can I get help?

  • Visit our Support Forum
  • Check our Plugin Page
  • Read our FAQ Section
